summary: Goldgroup Mining Inc. operates as a mining and metals company that focuses on gold production and exploration in Mexico. The company holds a 100% interest in the San Francisco project located in the State of Sonora. It also has a 100% interest in producing Cerro Prieto heap leach gold mine located in the State of Sonora. The company is based in Vancouver, Canada.
